entities.name: Eddy Díaz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eddy Javier Díaz is a Venezuelan former professional baseball second baseman. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Milwaukee Brewers in 1997. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp, and in the KBO League for the SK Wyverns and Hanwha Eagles.
